title: Sovereigns visual baseline palette
description: Named presentation colors, not world-simulation biome constants; final in-scene visual acceptance required.
usage_rules: Semantic UI tokens are preferred to one-off hex codes.
Map colors are initial art direction samples; physically grounded rendering may deviate by light, season, wetness and vegetation.
Faction palettes are generated from a constrained distinctness scheme and must use non-color markers.
All final UI pairings and overlays require actual rendered contrast and accessibility testing.
Do not infer material passability or hazard from color alone.
